acceptance_gate_results.principle: Only authenticated V662 and committed V663 bytes can seed requalification.
Scoped checks and independent terminal readers must pass before publication.
A separate process must reproduce the exact selected roster.
Fixed counts and complete arms prevent outcome-driven replacement.
Labels and baseline probabilities cannot enter predictor records.
Lag-eight updates and evaluator-only groups prevent future-label training.
Protocol and oracle fixtures cannot establish predictive benefit.
Requalification cannot erase historical exposure of selected groups.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: No-model tasks use an empty list and name historical identity separately.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Validity, readiness, benefit, retention, and freshness have separate principles and results.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure current monotonic time and phase spans without inherited or padded duration.
field_principles.evidence_protocol_ready_score: One requires exact sidecars and a valid terminal cold replay.
field_principles.field_principles: Carry these one-line reasons inside the terminal artifact.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Persist the terminal reader result; flagged evidence never opens readiness.
field_principles.fresh_confirmatory_claim_allowed: Every selected group was historically exposed, so this remains false.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every block names check, upstream, path, field, operator, expected, and observed.
field_principles.historical_failure_reconstruction: Separate preserved receipt bytes from unavailable historical process state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use a complete_ terminal prefix; completion alone is not scientific benefit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe current execution; historical GPU evidence is not a current model call.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Record planned and actual classes; blocked_no_run means no model work.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Count current loads, forwards, generations, and tokens separately from history.
field_principles.protocol_path: Name the exact authenticated role and feature contract.
field_principles.random_seed: Persist every stochastic-stage seed even when the selection salt is deterministic.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind configuration, immutable evidence, sidecars, and reduction.
field_principles.role_counts: Freeze 240 scored groups and eight disjoint fit-role pilots.
field_principles.rows: Each unit and arm keeps absolute metrics, numerator, denominator, seed, direction, censoring, and provenance.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Count independent groups; repeated arms, seeds, or windows never multiply them.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Separate producers, conductor pre-gates, and missing producers.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Bind commands, exits, worktree, log hashes, and independent terminal readers.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial; partial is unfinished owned work only.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Exact fixtures cannot establish learned semantic correctness or an oracle-distinct gain.

first_failure.principle: Protocol and oracle fixtures cannot establish predictive benefit.

historical_failure_reconstruction.cause_note: The terminal receipt is exact; the historical process state is unavailable.
